extraction.name: CONTEXTUAL
extraction.description: A dataset of 506 human-crafted instructions requiring context-sensitive reasoning over text-rich images across eight real-world scenarios: time reading, shopping, navigation, abstract scenes, mobile application, webpages, infographics, and miscellaneous natural scenes. Each instance contains an image, instruction, and human-written ground-truth response.
extraction.creator: Rohan Wadhawan, Hritik Bansal, Kai-Wei Chang, Nanyun Peng
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was collected through a multi-stage process: (1) Images were sourced from six different sources including LAION-5B (using keyword search with CLIP-retrieval UI), Rico Dataset, Open WebText Initiative screenshots, and existing VQA datasets (InfographicVQA, STVQA, ESTVQA). (2) Images underwent manual or heuristic-based filtering using PaddleOCR to detect text. (3) Authors were divided into two groups to annotate instruction-response pairs following specific guidelines. (4) MTurk workers verified 96% correctness of annotations, followed by cross-group review by authors to ensure quality, resulting in 506 final instances.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Web Scraping, Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw data sources include: (1) LAION-5B images retrieved via keyword search (e.g., 'clothes text', 'airports text'), (2) 66,000 UI screens from 9,300 Android apps in Rico Dataset, (3) Website screenshots from Open WebText Initiative links, (4) Images from InfographicVQA, STVQA, and ESTVQA test sets. Images were filtered using PaddleOCR text detection, selecting top 500 images with highest word counts for some categories.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Three-stage annotation process: Stage 1 involved manual and heuristic-based filtering of images (using PaddleOCR for text detection). Stage 2 divided authors into two groups, each annotating four specific categories following provided annotation guidelines. Stage 3 involved verification by MTurk workers (96% correctness rate), followed by cross-review between author groups to ensure guideline adherence and filter low-quality samples.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Verification process using MTurk workers found 96% of samples were annotated correctly. Incorrect samples were filtered out, and cross-review between author groups was performed to ensure guideline adherence and quality.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: Multiple annotations per item: initial annotation by author groups, verification by MTurk workers, and cross-review by the other author group
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: PaddleOCR (PP-OCRv4 model) was used to detect text in images and select top 500 images with highest number of words for annotation
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset consists of 506 samples with limited diversity in certain visual contexts. Training data for models shows imbalance in visual context representation, with datasets like COCO predominantly comprising natural scenes, leading to performance gaps across different categories.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset enables evaluation of models for real-world applications such as assisting visually impaired individuals in interpreting text-rich scenes (e.g., navigating maps in public spaces) and creative understanding of abstract text-rich images (e.g., memes).
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is designed for evaluating and testing large multimodal models' capability on context-sensitive text-rich visual reasoning. It facilitates model development through a validation set and benchmarking of foundation models.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset will release 100 samples as a validation set with reference responses, while keeping responses hidden for the remaining 406 samples. The validation samples are randomly selected to maintain proportional representation of each category consistent with the overall benchmark.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Manual and heuristic-based filtering was performed to select images for annotation. For Time, Shopping, Navigation, and Abstract categories, manual filtering was used. For Application Usage, Web Usage, Infographic, and Miscellaneous Natural Scenes, heuristic-based filtering using PaddleOCR was employed to detect text and select top 500 images with highest word count. A verification process filtered out incorrect samples, with 96% of samples verified as correct and low-quality samples removed.

name.evidence: In this paper, we introduce CONTEXTUAL, a novel dataset featuring human-crafted instructions that require context-sensitive reasoning for text-rich images.

description.evidence: we propose CONTEXTUAL, a Context-sensitive Text-rich visual reasoning dataset consisting of 506 challenging instructions for LMMs evaluation. CONTEXTUAL covers eight real-world scenarios with text-rich images: time reading, shopping, navigation, abstract scenes, mobile application, webpages, infographics, and miscellaneous natural scenes

rai:dataLimitations.evidence: The relative imbalance in performance across categories can be attributed to the lack of diverse visual contexts in their training data. For instance, the COCO dataset (Lin et al., 2014) used for vision-language alignment in the open models predominantly comprises natural scenes.

rai:dataSocialImpact.evidence: The ability to reason about the interactions between the text and visual context in the images powers many real-world applications. For example, interpreting text-rich scenes (e.g., navigating maps in public spaces) for assisting the visually impaired, and creative understanding of abstract text-rich images (e.g., memes).
